newsitem.title: USA: US spot MTBE unchanged despite bullish factors.
newsitem.headline: US spot MTBE unchanged despite bullish factors.

text.p: U.S. spot MTBE prices were largely unchanged in quiet trade this week despite strong NYMEX gasoline futures and soaring butane prices, players said on Thursday.
"There has just been alot of barrels and not many buyers," said one New York Harbor broker, adding blending economics were also poor.
The spread between reformulated and conventional gasoline is less than one cent, far below what is considered the three cent economical range.
MTBE producers were also heard hoping that several partially-filled chemical tankers preparing to leave the U.S. Gulf Coast by the end of the week would top up on MTBE.
In the Gulf Coast, spot Houston MTBE was heard traded Wednesday at 85.50 cents, unchanged from last week. The range on Thursday was assessed between 85.50/86.00 cents a gallon.
In New York Harbor, spot MTBE was also assessed unchanged at 88.50/89.50 cents.
Spot MTBE prices were considered weak compared to a 66 point gain on NYMEX December gasoline futures and a rally in spot normal butane prices in the U.S. Gulf Coast.
Normal butane, an MTBE feedstock, has soared at least four cents in the past two days amid speculation over exporting the material.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
